verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is confirmed Apache-2.0 licensed and distributed as open npm packages (@babylonjs/core), and community reports describe developers filing GitHub bug reports and seeing fixes merged within nightly builds, indicating the source is open, forkable, and modifiable in practice. Missing for 10: explicit product docs on the contribution/build-from-source workflow and any direct developer account of forking the engine to patch internals.
